findings.obligation: T1: Adapters outbound list into shared update code is an honest, stable two-way baseline of real type edges (P3)
findings.observation: Advisory, non-blocking. The baseline has 4 entries; three are real types (UpdateCancellationContext, UpdateKey, UpdateServiceBase`1) measured from the IL, not loosened. The fourth, "-> TEntity", is the base class type parameter that IlDependencies reports as a target; it is a reader artefact, not a dependency. ModuleRules.DomainReachesOnlyTheKernelAndTheBaseLibrary already treats GenericParameter as no edge (IsCompilerMade: "type is GenericParameter"), so enshrining it here is inconsistent and brittle: renaming the base class type parameter fails the list for no architectural reason. The oracle cannot filter it itself; the filter would live in ModuleRules.OutboundEdges.
findings.remediation: Oracle owner decides before craft: either keep the entry as a recorded reader artefact, or drop it (3 entries) and have the crafter make OutboundEdges skip GenericParameter targets. The three real edges stay listed either way, so nothing is loosened.
